videos.title: Bruno's Forgotten Hits: 1986
videos.description: Month by month, Bruno Brookes plays 12 lesser known hits of 1986! Including Culture Club and Pet Shop Boys, plus forgotten acts like Modern Talking, Sly Fox and Haywoode.

videos.title: The NOW Yearbook 1986
videos.description: Bruno Brookes flicks through the pages of another Yearbook. 1986 introduced us to Samantha Fox, Sinitta and Sigue Sigue Sputnik. But we also said a 'Final' goodbye to Wham.

videos.title: Way Back When! 1986
videos.description: Sixty minutes of lesser heard hits from 1986. Including Jaki Graham, Paul Simon, UB40, The Smiths and Queen.

videos.title: I Want My Music TV! Top 50
videos.description: Music TV continues with Bonnie Tyler, Sister Sledge & Madonna, through to million-selling hits from Frankie, Wham! & Soft Cell. These are the official biggest of the 80s.

videos.title: Get Fresh At The Weekend!
videos.description: It's the weekend, and we're showing out! Classic pop that has stood the test of time.

videos.title: Pop Gold! 80s v 90s
videos.description: Bruno Brookes with a quickfire party countdown crossing 2 decades - one from the 80s followed by another from the 90s! Expect Donna Summer, Steps, Sinitta & S-Club 7.

videos.description: Classic love songs from the NOW That's What I Call Music archive.

videos.title: Christmas No.1s of the 80s!
videos.description: A fine decade for Christmas chart toppers of all kinds! Includes seasonal favourites from Cliff and Shaky, along with unexpected entries from Pet Shop Boys and Jackie Wilson.

videos.title: All Day - Every Song A No.1!
videos.description: A choice selection of the 191 singles that reached the top of the UK charts in the 1980s.

videos.title: Every Number 1 of the 80s!
videos.description: Mark Goodier's 11-hour journey through the decade's biggest number 1 songs, from ABBA and Adam Ant to Wham!, Madonna, Rick Astley and Kylie Minogue.

videos.description: A choice selection of the 191 singles that reached the top of the UK charts in the 1980s.

videos.description: Twenty massive UK number 1 songs all about love and lust! Some happy, some sad, but all of them sung from the heart.

videos.title: Mark Goodier's US No.1s of 1989
videos.description: Sixty minutes of back to back US chart toppers from 1989 - none of which made the top spot in the UK! Including Bad English, Michael Damian, Martika and New Kids on the Block.

videos.title: Mark Goodier's US No.1s of 1987
videos.description: Sixty minutes of back to back US chart toppers from 1987 - none of which made the top spot in the UK! Including U2, Gregory Abbott, Billy Vera and Bob Seger.

videos.title: Mark Goodier's US No.1s of 1985
videos.description: Sixty minutes of back to back US chart toppers from 1985 - some you might know well, some you might not! Including Jan Hammer, REO Speedwagon and Ready for the World.

videos.title: Mark Goodier's US No.1s of 1983
videos.description: Sixty minutes of back to back US chart toppers from 1983 - some you might know well, some you might not! Including Toto, Dolly and Kenny, Men at Work and Michael Sembello.

videos.title: Mark Goodier's US No.1s of 1981
videos.description: Sixty minutes of back to back US chart toppers from 1981 - none of which made the top spot in the UK! Including Rick Springfield, Eddie Rabbit, Starsound and Dolly Parton.
